entries.note: acceptance[0]: '任意插件卸载、覆盖 service 或动态 mount 都不能替换 kernel policy/audit/signature verifier' (no plugin unload, service override, or dynamic mount can replace the kernel's policy/audit/signature verifier). Covered for ctx.get('trustKernel') and the root context's own direct property read in every tested vector (delete-then-reprovide, direct store reassignment, Impl mutation, root-fiber-store key, reflect.props key, unload, dynamic mount). Per spec/first100/exec/BLOCKED-QUEUE.md's BLOCKED-011 final resolution (ANSWERED-BY-USER, 2026-09-01): 3 further property-access-only residual vectors (self-fiber poisoning, ancestor-fiber poisoning/vector G, wholesale root-store replacement/vector H, all in pin-hardening.spec.ts) are independently proven currently unreachable by any real consumer (exhaustive grep: zero real code anywhere reads ctx.trustKernel via property access; the sole real consumer, apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts:314, uses ctx.get exclusively) and are closed to real code by the CI-enforced scripts/verify-trust-kernel-property-access.ts gate, not eliminated at the Cordis mechanism level. Clause 0's real security intent (no enforcement-point-reachable bypass -- there is currently no real enforcement point to bypass at all) is accepted as satisfied on this basis, with a new standing hard-trigger rule requiring the vendored Cordis Fiber structural fix (Option A) before any future epic wires a real enforcement point (~W6).

entries.note: acceptance[0]: '篡改任一测试日志、二进制或配置后 evidence verify 失败' (tampering any test log, binary, or config makes evidence verify fail). P-stage's three cases prove byte-level mutation detection (log, artifact, and the evidence.json/recordDigest/signature triple itself). F-stage's cases prove the stronger deletion-class tampering (not just corrupted, but entirely absent) across every required-entry kind: gate log, artifact file, the manifest sidecar itself, and -- BLOCKED-024's specific elevated-bar requirement -- a required GATE's key deleted entirely from requiredGates with a forged self-consistent signature ('detects a required gate silently deleted...'), independently reproduced by the Reviewer via their own adversarial script (not just re-running this test) before ACCEPT. BLOCKED-024's other two required attacks: the artifact-key-deletion-plus-missing-manifest regression the Reviewer re-verified is covered jointly by the manifest-sidecar-deleted and artifact-file-deleted titles above (both real, both already covered here). The Reviewer's third attack (gate-key deletion AND artifact-key deletion combined in one bundle) was originally verified only via the Reviewer's own standalone adversarial script, with no dedicated permanent regression test -- flagged as a real gap rather than glossed over, per the delegate's request to verify all three attacks are genuinely reflected in this epic's own green cells' expectCasesMatched. The delegate ruled this gap must close before P0-07's acceptance, given P0-07 is the ledger's own trust anchor: a BLOCKED-005 supplement (supplementSeq 1) now provides a permanent regression test for exactly this combination, with a mandatory sensitivity (mutation) proof -- since the covered behavior already existed and was already correct, a genuine RED against the unmodified tree was unobtainable, so a real mutant (an early-return that would mask the second fault) was independently constructed and applied by the Supervisor, confirmed to drive the new case RED, then reverted to confirm GREEN -- proving the case is not vacuously true.
